title: The Year the Web Got a Business Model
narrative: The web stops being a research project and starts being an industry. Netscape is founded, the first banner ad sells, the first secure purchase happens, and the W3C is created to keep it all open. Yahoo! turns a list of links into a front door, and PHP is born in a developer's spare scripts.
